description: This file defines the class OX_Vast_Url with static methods for URL parsing, construction, and redirection, tailored for handling current URL components and query strings within a web application.

classes.name: OX_Vast_Url
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for URL manipulation, including retrieving current URL components, query string handling, and redirection.

methods.name: getCurrentUrl
methods.description: Returns the full current URL including host, script name, and query string.

methods.name: getCurrentUrlWithoutQueryString
methods.description: Returns the current URL without the query string.

methods.name: getCurrentUrlWithoutFileName
methods.description: Returns the current URL without the filename, including host and directory path.

methods.name: getCurrentScriptPath
methods.description: Returns the directory path of the current script with trailing slash.

methods.name: getCurrentScriptName
methods.description: Returns the script name or path component of the current URL.

methods.name: getCurrentHost
methods.description: Returns the current host URL, including protocol.

methods.name: getCurrentQueryString
methods.description: Returns the current URL's query string with leading '?'.

methods.name: getArrayFromCurrentQueryString
methods.description: Parses the current query string into an associative array.

methods.name: getCurrentQueryStringWithParametersModified
methods.description: Returns the current query string with specified parameters added or modified.

methods.name: getQueryStringFromParameters
methods.description: Constructs a query string from an array of parameters, supporting array values.

methods.name: redirectToReferer
methods.description: Redirects to the HTTP referer if available, otherwise to the current URL without query string.

methods.name: redirectToUrl
methods.description: Redirects to a specified URL and terminates execution.

methods.name: getReferer
methods.description: Returns the HTTP referer header or false if not set.
